scope: Independent source review plus a separately pinned actual-world historical R7 negative fixture. No final-asset positive, import or rendering was executed by QA for this packet.

findings.finding: The initial player pause/focus callbacks reset the secondary spring and facial blink, contradicting the component pause-hold contract and visibly snapping a nonneutral pose.
findings.resolution: Root removed quality reset calls from pause and focus callbacks. The reviewed source retains explicit reset/teleport/death handling and pausable updates. A real combined nonneutral pause/focus regression is now in the new integration fixture.

findings.finding: Player creation ignored configure return values for secondary/facial/material controllers, so a functional older hero could run with the two new features absent.
findings.resolution: New actual-world suite requires all three configured controllers, exactly one 164-bone rig and one motion modifier, one small skinned four-morph face, actual semantic masks, six material profile domains and shared live skeleton binding. The fresh R7 counterexample passes 7 of10 and fails the three expected feature admissions.

findings.finding: The first capture version pinned raw assets and skeleton pose but omitted imported-scene freshness, morph/secondary offsets and loaded scene files.
findings.resolution: Reviewed capture now verifies source and destination MD5 stamps, pins imported SCN SHA256, hashes source scenes, includes full-precision skeleton/morph/secondary state and checks source/import bytes unchanged. Python runner independently checks recorded imported SCN and stamp SHA256, all images and six matched pair camera/pose/exposure/phase fields.

composition_observations: PBR calibration owns six named non-secondary profile types; secondary owns four different domains, including the trailing Cobalt lotus brocade border. The sets are disjoint.

LOD binding extracts only named body and bow mesh clones, discards candidate facial nodes/rigs, validates named bind order/rest and attaches clones to the existing skeleton before material/secondary calibration. The single original face remains the sole facial-controller target. Actual LOD images and switch behavior remain separate pending gates.
The runtime connects its recovery handler before ActionBuffer so movement unlock precedes a legitimate queued dispatch. Pending input never selects action audio directly.

Actual kit events reach action audio after runtime phase changes and before public combat_event observers. Lethal damage receipts reach consume_damage before the alive guard; defeat stops voices and respawn/reset set the real receiver generation. This source ordering does not establish audible quality.

new_fixture.positive_status: UNRUN pending final accepted source and fresh imports
checks_designed: Actual source/import freshness and one-rig/controller admission.
Actual imported white-RGB semantic-alpha domains with anchored non-secondary surfaces and per-instance profile separation.
Real movement and accepted draw seed nonzero spring and facial effort through actual player updates.
Pause and focus callback preserve complete spring, facial, shader-uniform and morph state; resume advances one tick.
Actual teleport/reset, lethal receiver/audio ordering, death facial state and authority respawn preserve owned resource identity.
One hundred actual player resets retain the same face, mesh, skin and material resources; teardown releases owned nodes.
new_fixture.dependent_execution_policy: Lifecycle checks run only after every admission and present import-freshness check passes. Old R7 rejection does not execute these branches.

limits: The archived R7 negative pins its exact earlier fixture/source hashes; the current fixture adds dependency pinning and stricter fail-closed sequencing. No unchanged-test before/after claim is made until the final positive is executed.
A later scratch run occurred after raw R4f staging but before editor import. It is not classified as R7, and is not substituted for the preserved fresh-R7 negative or a positive run.
No production art, cloth collision, facial realism, actual LOD performance, physical GPU, Windows, listening or native online acceptance.
